meta.name: opencode-groq-api
meta.description: 用 Groq 的免費 API 做「語音轉字幕」與「逐字稿清洗」，並把整條流程包成可重複使用的技能。說「語音轉字幕」「影片上字幕」「做逐字稿」「Whisper」「Groq」「把錄音整理成講義」「把 API 變成工具」時載入。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将语音文件快速转成字幕和逐字稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将录音或视频转成可编辑的文字稿
copy.tagline_en: Instantly convert audio to subtitles and transcripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn recordings or videos into editable text

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你提供录音或影片文件，Claude会先调用Groq的Whisper模型转成字幕（.srt），再用文字模型清洗成讲义（.md）。
howto.when: 当你说出“语音转字幕”、“做逐字稿”、“把录音整理成讲义”等关键词，或提到“Whisper”、“Groq”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段录音转成字幕，再整理成讲义。
清洗这段逐字稿，去掉口语词并分段。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you provide an audio/video file, Claude uses Groq's Whisper to generate subtitles (.srt) and then cleans the transcript into lecture notes (.md).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "speech to text", "transcript cleaning", "convert recording to notes", or mention "Whisper" or "Groq".

say_en.text: Transcribe this recording and turn it into subtitles and notes.
Clean this transcript by removing filler words and adding paragraphs.
